rule: TML row dated apart from its event's main draw (qualifying dated the day before or after it; matches of 2026 and Davis Cup rubbers dated by the day played): given the main draw's first date
walkover (no point played): kept, never evaluated
box score blank for both players: missing
box score with some counts blank (other than service games): missing
service games blank, the other eight counts present: kept, service-game rates missing
service games recorded as 0 with serve points played: service games treated as missing
box score check: second-serve points won exceed second serves; box score dropped
box score check: break points saved exceed break points faced; box score dropped
box score check: service games disagree with the games in the score by more than one, whether tiebreaks count as service games or not; service games dropped, the other counts kept
box score check (added): double faults exceed second serves; box score dropped
box score check (added): breaks conceded exceed service games (checked where service games pass B5); box score dropped
box score check (added): fewer than 4.5 serve points per game in the score (a game has at least 4 points): the counts cover part of the match; box score dropped
box scores exchanged between winner and loser (confirmed by the WTA's own statistics, an official feed or the score): the nine counts exchanged back (decision 2026-10-08)
service-game counts exchanged between winner and loser: exchanged back (decision 2026-10-08)
second serves booked as first serves (Roland Garros 2022-2025, Paris Olympics 2024): first serves in and points won on each serve from the official record (decision 2026-10-08)

service games the score disproves or leaves blank (Australian Open, Roland Garros): both set from the score's alternation of serve, from the Slam's own record of who served first (decision 2026-10-08)
